downloads.justification: Required to detect when the user starts a download, pause the default browser download, and hand off the request to the local MJDM turbo engine. If the desktop app is offline, the download is immediately resumed in the browser.

nativeMessaging.justification: Required to communicate with the local mjdm-nmhost companion binary via stdio IPC on localhost. No external network connections are made.

cookies.justification: Required to pass relevant session authentication cookies to the local download engine for the specific file being downloaded, preventing HTTP 401/403 errors on private/gated downloads.

storage.justification: Used exclusively to store user-configured extension preferences, such as domain bypass lists, interception toggles, and minimum file size thresholds.

contextMenus.justification: Allows users to right-click on any hyperlink, image, or media asset and choose 'Download with MJDM' or 'Download All Links with MJDM'.

scripting.justification: Used to inject the client-side link grabber dialog and floating video sniffer widget when the user requests media detection on a webpage.

webRequest.justification: Used in Firefox or supported browsers to inspect response headers (Content-Disposition, Content-Type) to identify downloadable file streams before the browser initiates a full-page navigation.

<all_urls>.justification: Necessary because the user can download files from any website across the open internet. The extension does not inspect web traffic except when a file download is initiated by the user.
